From Wiktionary, the free dictionary

English

[edit]

Etymology

[edit]

Borrowed from French artiste. Doublet of artist.

Pronunciation

[edit]
  • (US) IPA(key): /ɑɹˈtiːst/
  • Audio (US):(file)

Noun

[edit]

artiste (plural artistes)

  1. A public performer, especially of song or dance.
  2. Any person with artistic skill, such as a hairdresser or a cook.

Translations

[edit]
performer
  • Greek: αρτίστα (el) f (artísta)
  • Ukrainian: арти́ст (uk) m (artýst), арти́стка (uk) f (artýstka)

Anagrams

[edit]
  • artiest, iratest, attires, ratites, striate, ratties, tastier

Albanian

[edit]

Noun

[edit]

artiste f

  1. artist (person who creates art)

Related terms

[edit]
  • artist

French

Etymology

    • Audio (Canada (Shawinigan)):(file)
    • Audio (France (Vosges)):(file)
    • Audio (France (Lyon)):(file)

    • Audio (France (Somain)):(file)
    • Homophone: artistes
    • Hyphenation: ar‧tiste

    Noun

    [edit]

    1. artist
      Hyponyms: peintre, sculpteur, poète, cinéaste, dessinateur, musicien
